items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: I was very aware of Ellington and Coltrane’s duo recording, and Ellington played something like that on one of the songs.

ctx.x: I love this accompaniment you came up with.

You know that probably, that straight eighth note stuff in the right hand, where do those things come from. I was very aware of Ellington and Coltrane’s duo recording, and Ellington played something like that on one of the songs. I also played a lot of Ravel piano music, that idea. You know I think as an orchestrator a lot when I’m playing piano and especially in a duo setting where there’s no other texture I’m really thinking as an orchestrator. So that was an album called “Telepathy” that Bobby Shew said,…
Yeah. It’s a marvelous record. Was that particular accompaniment spontaneous?
